blocks.zh: 無菌定義、SAL、微生物滅活動力學、滅菌方法層級 | Sterility Definition, SAL, Kinetics, Preference Hierarchy
blocks.en: Sterility Definition, SAL, Kinetics, Preference Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 無菌定義與 SAL Sterility Definition and SAL
blocks.en: Sterility Definition and SAL

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SAL ≤10⁻⁶
blocks.en: Core Concept: SAL ≤10⁻⁶

blocks.zh: SAL（無菌保證水準）是表達滅菌製品中殘存活微生物的機率。SAL ≤10⁻⁶ 意味著：每 100 萬個已滅菌單位中，有活微生物存在的可能性不超過 1 個。
blocks.en: SAL (sterility assurance level) expresses the probability of a viable microorganism being present in a sterilised product. SAL ≤10⁻⁶ means that the probability of a viable microorganism being present is no more than 1 in 1 million sterilised units.

blocks.zh: 監管臨界值 Regulatory Critical Limit
blocks.en: Regulatory Critical Limit

blocks.zh: 所有最終滅菌方法的共同要求 — Universal requirement for all terminal sterilisation methods
blocks.en: Universal requirement for all terminal sterilisation methods

blocks.zh: 指數滅活動力學 Exponential Inactivation Kinetics
blocks.en: Exponential Inactivation Kinetics

blocks.zh: 微生物被滅活的過程遵循指數定律（Exponential Law）。這意味著：
blocks.en: Microbial inactivation follows an exponential law. This means that:

blocks.zh: 微生物存活的機率永遠不為零（理論上），只能趨近於零
blocks.en: The probability of microbial survival is (theoretically) never zero; it can only approach zero

blocks.zh: 初始生物負載（Bioburden）越高，達到相同 SAL 所需的暴露時間越長
blocks.en: The higher the initial bioburden, the longer the exposure needed to reach the same SAL

blocks.zh: SAL 10⁻⁶ 是基於統計模型與驗證數據建立的，而非針對每個製品的實測結果
blocks.en: SAL 10⁻⁶ is established from statistical models and validation data, not from test results on each individual product

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 就像用燈光照射一個黑暗房間：開燈後黑暗快速消散，但從未「絕對為零」；每一次減半的黑暗對應著微生物的指數減少。SAL 就是量化「還有多黑」的標準。
blocks.en: It is like shining a light into a dark room: the darkness fades quickly once the light is on, but it never reaches "absolute zero". Each halving of the darkness corresponds to an exponential reduction in microorganisms. SAL is the standard that quantifies "how dark it still is".

blocks.zh: 滅菌方法選擇層級 Sterilisation Preference Hierarchy
blocks.en: Sterilisation Preference Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 滅菌層級的法規邏輯 Regulatory Logic of the Hierarchy
blocks.en: Regulatory Logic of the Hierarchy

blocks.zh: Ph.Eur. 5.1.1 明確建立了一個「最終滅菌優先」的原則，原因如下：
blocks.en: Ph.Eur. 5.1.1 explicitly establishes a principle of "terminal sterilisation first", for the following reasons:

blocks.zh: 最終滅菌（Terminal Sterilisation）：在產品完成包裝並密封後施予滅菌，人員干預已結束，污染風險最低。可實施參數放行（Parametric Release），以製程數據代替末端無菌試驗。
blocks.en: Terminal sterilisation: sterilisation is applied after the product has been packaged and sealed, when human intervention is finished, so the contamination risk is lowest. Parametric release can be applied, using process data in place of the end-product sterility test.

blocks.zh: 無菌組裝（Aseptic Assembly）：每次人員干預都是一個潛在污染事件。無法實施參數放行，每批均需通過 2.6.1 無菌試驗。
blocks.en: Aseptic assembly: every human intervention is a potential contamination event. Parametric release is not possible, and every batch must pass the sterility test (2.6.1).

blocks.zh: 配方因素對滅菌效果的影響 Formulation Factors
blocks.en: Formulation Factors

blocks.zh: 水活性（Aw）：影響蒸汽和乾熱滅菌效果；Aw 低的製品（如油性製品）耐熱性更強但蒸汽滅菌效果差
blocks.en: Water activity (Aw): affects the efficacy of steam and dry heat sterilisation; products with low Aw (such as oily products) are more heat-resistant, but steam sterilisation is less effective for them

blocks.zh: pH：影響微生物耐熱性；酸性或鹼性環境可增強熱滅菌效果
blocks.en: pH: affects the heat resistance of microorganisms; acidic or alkaline conditions can enhance heat sterilisation

blocks.zh: 抑菌成分：防腐劑（如苯甲醇）可提供額外滅菌保證，降低所需 F₀
blocks.en: Bacteriostatic components: preservatives (such as benzyl alcohol) can provide additional sterility assurance and reduce the required F₀

blocks.zh: 生物負載（Bioburden）：初始污染水平越低，達到 SAL 10⁻⁶ 所需暴露越短
blocks.en: Bioburden: the lower the initial contamination level, the shorter the exposure needed to reach SAL 10⁻⁶

blocks.zh: 參數放行 Parametric Release
blocks.en: Parametric Release

blocks.zh: 定義：以完全驗證的滅菌製程的製程數據（時間、溫度、F₀）作為放行依據，而非依賴末端無菌試驗樣本結果。
blocks.en: Definition: release based on process data (time, temperature, F₀) from a fully validated sterilisation process, rather than on end-product sterility test results.

blocks.zh: 前提：僅適用於完全驗證的最終滅菌（蒸汽、乾熱、輻射），且需主管機關（Competent Authority）核准。
blocks.en: Prerequisite: applicable only to fully validated terminal sterilisation (steam, dry heat, radiation) and requires approval by the Competent Authority.

blocks.zh: Steam Sterilisation / 蒸汽滅菌
blocks.en: Steam Sterilisation

blocks.zh: 原理、參考週期、F₀ 概念、F_bio 公式、設備要求、常規控制 | Principle, Reference Cycle, F₀, F_bio Formula, Equipment, Routine Control
blocks.en: Principle, Reference Cycle, F₀, F_bio Formula, Equipment, Routine Control

blocks.zh: 原理 Principle
blocks.en: Principle

blocks.zh: 蒸汽冷凝熱轉移機制 Steam Condensation Heat Transfer
blocks.en: Heat Transfer by Steam Condensation

blocks.zh: 飽和蒸汽在接觸冷表面時發生冷凝（Condensation），釋放的冷凝潛熱（Latent Heat of Condensation）約為 2257 kJ/kg（在 100°C 下），比熱空氣高出約 5 倍以上。這就是為何蒸汽比乾熱更高效地將熱能傳遞給製品。
blocks.en: When saturated steam contacts a cold surface it condenses, releasing latent heat of condensation of about 2257 kJ/kg (at 100°C), more than 5 times that of hot air. This is why steam transfers heat to the product more efficiently than dry heat.

blocks.zh: 空氣排除的關鍵性 Why Air Removal is Critical
blocks.en: Why Air Removal is Critical

blocks.zh: 空氣（非冷凝氣體）若殘留於高壓鍋腔體中，會：
blocks.en: If air (a non-condensable gas) remains in the autoclave chamber, it will:

blocks.zh: 形成「冷點」（Cold Spots）——空氣層阻斷蒸汽與物品表面的接觸
blocks.en: Form "cold spots": the air layer blocks contact between steam and the surface of the load

blocks.zh: 壓力計讀數正常，但溫度可能低於要求（因空氣佔據腔體空間）
blocks.en: Give normal pressure gauge readings while the temperature may be below the requirement (because air occupies chamber space)

blocks.zh: 使滅菌週期失效，可能導致 F₀ 不足
blocks.en: Invalidate the sterilisation cycle and possibly lead to insufficient F₀

blocks.zh: 密閉容器滅菌 Closed Container Sterilisation
blocks.en: Closed Container Sterilisation

blocks.zh: 對於密閉容器（如玻璃安瓿、西林瓶），蒸汽不能直接進入容器內部，因此必須：
blocks.en: For sealed containers (such as glass ampoules and vials), steam cannot enter the container directly, so it is necessary to:

blocks.zh: 通過熱傳導方式讓容器內容物達到滅菌溫度
blocks.en: Bring the container contents to sterilisation temperature by heat conduction

blocks.zh: 確認最慢升溫位置的 F₀ 達標
blocks.en: Confirm that the required F₀ is achieved at the slowest-to-heat position

blocks.zh: 使用蒸汽-空氣混合（Steam-Air Mixture）或過熱水噴淋平衡容器內外壓力，防止容器破裂
blocks.en: Use a steam-air mixture or superheated water spray to balance the pressure inside and outside the containers and prevent container breakage

blocks.zh: 參考週期與 F₀ 概念 Reference Cycle and F₀ Concept
blocks.en: Reference Cycle and F₀ Concept

blocks.zh: 蒸汽滅菌關鍵臨界值 Steam Sterilisation Critical Limits
blocks.en: Steam Sterilisation Critical Limits

blocks.zh: F₀ ≥ 8 min（法規最低值）
blocks.en: F₀ ≥ 8 min (regulatory minimum)

blocks.zh: 最低溫度 110°C
blocks.en: Minimum temperature 110°C

blocks.zh: 參考週期：121°C / 15 min
blocks.en: Reference cycle: 121°C / 15 min

blocks.zh: F_bio 公式詳解 F_bio Formula Explained
blocks.en: F_bio Formula Explained

blocks.zh: F_bio 是以生物指示劑（BI）為基礎的生物學等效滅菌時間。公式的含義：
blocks.en: F_bio is the biologically equivalent sterilisation time based on a biological indicator (BI). The elements of the formula:

blocks.zh: D₁₂₁：在 121°C 下，使孢子數減少 1 個對數值（90%）所需的時間（分鐘）。標準 BI 的 D₁₂₁ 通常為 1.5–2.5 min。
blocks.en: D₁₂₁: the time (in minutes) at 121°C required to reduce the spore count by 1 log (90%). The D₁₂₁ of a standard BI is typically 1.5–2.5 min.

blocks.zh: log₁₀ N₀ − log₁₀ N：孢子數從初始值降低的對數減少量，即滅菌週期的「有效對數殺滅數」。
blocks.en: log₁₀ N₀ − log₁₀ N: the log reduction in spore count from the initial value, i.e. the "effective number of log kills" of the sterilisation cycle.

blocks.zh: 若要達到 SAL 10⁻⁶，對於初始孢子數 N₀ = 10⁶，需要 N = 1 個存活者，故 log reduction = 6。
blocks.en: To reach SAL 10⁻⁶ with an initial spore count N₀ = 10⁶, N = 1 survivor is required, so the log reduction = 6.

blocks.zh:
範例 Example:
  D₁₂₁ = 2.0 min
  N₀ = 10⁶ (initial spore count)
  目標 SAL: 10⁻⁶ → log reduction = 12
  F_bio = 2.0 × (6 − (−6)) = 2.0 × 12 = 24 min
  → 需要至少 24 min 的等效暴露
blocks.en:
Example:
  D₁₂₁ = 2.0 min
  N₀ = 10⁶ (initial spore count)
  Target SAL: 10⁻⁶ → log reduction = 12
  F_bio = 2.0 × (6 − (−6)) = 2.0 × 12 = 24 min
  → at least 24 min of equivalent exposure is required

blocks.zh: F₀ 工業實務 Industry F₀ Practice
blocks.en: Industry F₀ Practice

blocks.zh: 法規底線：F₀ ≥8 min（Ph.Eur. 最慢升溫位置）
blocks.en: Regulatory floor: F₀ ≥8 min (Ph.Eur., at the slowest-to-heat position)

blocks.zh: 工業慣例：多數製程設計目標 F₀ ≥15–25 min（121°C）
blocks.en: Industry convention: most processes are designed for F₀ ≥15–25 min (121°C)

blocks.zh: 兩種驗證策略：
blocks.en: Two validation strategies:

blocks.zh: Overkill 法：F₀ ≥12 min（對最具耐熱性 BI 而言），不依賴生物負載數據，保守但簡便
blocks.en: Overkill approach: F₀ ≥12 min (for the most heat-resistant BI), independent of bioburden data; conservative but simple

blocks.zh: 生物負載基礎驗證法：基於實際生物負載水平計算所需 F₀，允許較短暴露時間但需嚴格的生物負載監控
blocks.en: Bioburden-based approach: calculates the required F₀ from the actual bioburden level, allowing a shorter exposure time but requiring strict bioburden monitoring

blocks.zh: 常規控制 Routine Control
blocks.en: Routine Control

blocks.zh: 蒸汽滅菌常規監控要求 Routine Monitoring Requirements
blocks.en: Routine Monitoring Requirements for Steam Sterilisation

blocks.zh: 每週期記錄腔體壓力與最冷位置溫度曲線（Pressure and Temperature Profile at Coldest Position）
blocks.en: Record the chamber pressure and the temperature profile at the coldest position (Pressure and Temperature Profile at Coldest Position) for every cycle

blocks.zh: 記錄滅菌時間（暴露時間）
blocks.en: Record the sterilisation time (exposure time)

blocks.zh: 計算並記錄 F₀ 值（where possible）
blocks.en: Calculate and record the F₀ value (where possible)

blocks.zh: 化學指示劑（Chemical Indicators）用於確認蒸汽穿透
blocks.en: Chemical indicators to confirm steam penetration

blocks.zh: 生物指示劑（Biological Indicators, 5.1.2）用於週期性驗證（非每週期）
blocks.en: Biological indicators (5.1.2) for periodic verification (not every cycle)

blocks.zh: 密閉容器：確認最慢升溫密閉容器位置的溫度達標
blocks.en: Closed containers: confirm that the temperature at the slowest-to-heat container position meets the requirement

blocks.zh: Dry Heat Sterilisation / 乾熱滅菌
blocks.en: Dry Heat Sterilisation

blocks.zh: 原理、參考條件、除熱原驗證、設備、常規控制 | Principle, Reference Conditions, Depyrogenation, Equipment, Routine Control
blocks.en: Principle, Reference Conditions, Depyrogenation, Equipment, Routine Control

blocks.zh: 原理與設備 Principle and Equipment
blocks.en: Principle and Equipment

blocks.zh: 乾熱 vs 蒸汽：何時選乾熱？ When to Choose Dry Heat?
blocks.en: Dry Heat vs Steam: When to Choose Dry Heat?

blocks.zh: 不耐蒸汽潮濕的製品：油性製品（Oily Products）、粉末（Powders）、玻璃器具（Glassware）、金屬器械
blocks.en: Products that cannot tolerate steam and moisture: oily products, powders, glassware, metal instruments

blocks.zh: 需要除熱原的場合：注射用玻璃容器（Vials, Ampoules）在灌裝前需經除熱原處理
blocks.en: Where depyrogenation is needed: glass containers for injectables (vials, ampoules) require depyrogenation before filling

blocks.zh: 熱傳導性差：乾熱的殺菌效率遠低於蒸汽，故需更高溫度（160°C vs 121°C）或更長時間
blocks.en: Poor heat transfer: dry heat is far less efficient than steam at killing microorganisms, so a higher temperature (160°C vs 121°C) or a longer time is needed

blocks.zh: 乾熱滅菌關鍵臨界值 Dry Heat Critical Limits
blocks.en: Dry Heat Critical Limits
Sterilisation: 160°C / ≥2 h

blocks.zh: 除熱原：>220°C（驗證時間）
blocks.en: Depyrogenation: >220°C (validated time)

blocks.zh: 除熱原驗證：3 log₁₀ 內毒素降低
blocks.en: Depyrogenation validation: 3 log₁₀ endotoxin reduction

blocks.zh: 除熱原（Depyrogenation）特別說明
blocks.en: Depyrogenation: Special Notes

blocks.zh: 熱原（Pyrogen）主要指細菌內毒素（Bacterial Endotoxin），是革蘭氏陰性菌細胞壁脂多醣（LPS），具有強烈的致熱原性（Pyrogenicity）。
blocks.en: Pyrogens are mainly bacterial endotoxins, the lipopolysaccharides (LPS) of the cell wall of Gram-negative bacteria, which are strongly pyrogenic.

blocks.zh: 3 log₁₀ 降低：接受標準為將已知量的耐熱內毒素（Heat-resistant endotoxin challenge）降低至少 1000 倍（3 個對數值）。
blocks.en: 3 log₁₀ reduction: the acceptance criterion is a reduction of at least 1000-fold (3 log) in a known quantity of heat-resistant endotoxin challenge.

blocks.zh: 生物指示劑無需使用：除熱原驗證不使用 BI，而是以特定濃度的內毒素標準品作為挑戰，用 LAL 或 rFC 法定量驗證後的殘留內毒素量。
blocks.en: No biological indicator is used: depyrogenation validation does not use a BI; instead it uses an endotoxin standard of a defined concentration as the challenge, and the residual endotoxin after the process is quantified by the LAL or rFC method.

blocks.zh: 注意：除熱原條件（>220°C）遠高於滅菌條件（160°C），實際上也同時完成了滅菌，但重點目標是去除內毒素。
blocks.en: Note: the depyrogenation conditions (>220°C) are far above the sterilisation conditions (160°C), so sterilisation is in effect achieved at the same time, but the target of the process is the removal of endotoxin.

blocks.zh: 隧道式除熱原機 Depyrogenation Tunnel
blocks.en: Depyrogenation Tunnel

blocks.zh: 現代無菌製藥工廠大量使用連續式隧道烘箱（Depyrogenation Tunnel），玻璃西林瓶從一端進入、在高溫帶（>300°C）中完成除熱原，從另一端以無菌狀態進入 Grade A 灌裝區。
blocks.en: Modern aseptic pharmaceutical plants make extensive use of continuous tunnel ovens (depyrogenation tunnels): glass vials enter at one end, are depyrogenated in the high-temperature zone (>300°C), and leave at the other end in a sterile state and enter the Grade A filling area.

blocks.zh: 隧道驗證的挑戰：確保傳送帶速度與加熱帶溫度組合在最差條件（Worst Case）下仍能達到 3 log₁₀ 內毒素降低。
blocks.en: The challenge in tunnel validation: ensure that the combination of conveyor speed and heating zone temperature still achieves a 3 log₁₀ endotoxin reduction under worst-case conditions.

blocks.zh: Ionising Radiation Sterilisation / 游離輻射滅菌
blocks.en: Ionising Radiation Sterilisation

blocks.zh: 三種輻射類型、25 kGy 參考劑量、劑量測定、常規監控 | Three Types, 25 kGy, Dosimetry, Routine Control
blocks.en: Three Types, 25 kGy, Dosimetry, Routine Control

blocks.zh: 游離輻射關鍵值
blocks.en: Key Value for Ionising Radiation

blocks.zh: 25 kGy（參考劑量）
blocks.en: 25 kGy (reference dose)

blocks.zh: 實際劑量可依生物負載驗證調整（如 15 kGy 或 35 kGy），但需有完整的 SAL ≤10⁻⁶ 驗證數據
blocks.en: The actual dose may be adjusted based on bioburden validation (for example 15 kGy or 35 kGy), but complete validation data demonstrating SAL ≤10⁻⁶ are required

blocks.zh: 劑量測定（Dosimetry）的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of Dosimetry

blocks.zh: 輻射滅菌無法像蒸汽滅菌用溫度/壓力來實時監測滅菌效果。劑量測定（Dosimetry）是唯一的製程控制手段：
blocks.en: Unlike steam sterilisation, where temperature and pressure allow real-time monitoring of sterilisation efficacy, radiation sterilisation cannot be monitored this way. Dosimetry is the only means of process control:

blocks.zh: 使用劑量計（Dosimeters）放置於製品最難穿透位置
blocks.en: Place dosimeters at the position of the product that is hardest to penetrate

blocks.zh: 劑量測定系統必須可溯源至國家標準（Traceable to National Standards）
blocks.en: The dosimetry system must be traceable to national standards

blocks.zh: 確認最小劑量（Minimum Dose）≥ 驗證所需劑量，最大劑量（Maximum Dose）不超過製品耐受上限
blocks.en: Confirm that the minimum dose is ≥ the dose required by validation, and that the maximum dose does not exceed the upper tolerance limit of the product

blocks.zh: 為何輻射滅菌不依賴 BI？
blocks.en: Why Doesn't Radiation Sterilisation Rely on BIs?

blocks.zh: 蒸汽滅菌用 BI 確認熱穿透；輻射滅菌用劑量計（物理測量）直接測量製品實際接受的輻射能量，比 BI 更直接、更可靠。BI 在輻射滅菌中主要用於特殊產品（組織/細胞產品）或作為附加驗證工具。
blocks.en: Steam sterilisation uses BIs to confirm heat penetration; radiation sterilisation uses dosimeters (physical measurement) to measure directly the radiation energy actually received by the product, which is more direct and more reliable than a BI. In radiation sterilisation, BIs are used mainly for special products (tissue/cell products) or as an additional validation tool.

blocks.zh: Gas / Vapour Phase Sterilisation / 氣體（蒸氣相）滅菌
blocks.en: Gas / Vapour Phase Sterilisation

blocks.zh: 兩大類滅菌劑、三相製程、關鍵參數、殘留物控制 | Two Agent Classes, Three Phases, Critical Parameters, Residuals
blocks.en: Two Agent Classes, Three Phases, Critical Parameters, Residuals

blocks.zh: EtO 的特別警示 EtO Safety Alert
blocks.en: EtO Safety Alert

blocks.zh: Ph.Eur. 5.1.1 明確標示 EtO 為具有細胞毒性（Cytotoxic）、致癌性（Carcinogenic）、致突變性（Mutagenic）的烷化劑。因此：
blocks.en: Ph.Eur. 5.1.1 explicitly identifies EtO as an alkylating agent that is cytotoxic, carcinogenic and mutagenic. Therefore:

blocks.zh: 充分的通氣（Aeration）是必須的，確保殘留 EtO 及其副產物（Ethylene Chlorohydrin, Ethylene Glycol）低於毒性閾值
blocks.en: Adequate aeration is essential, to ensure that residual EtO and its by-products (ethylene chlorohydrin, ethylene glycol) are below toxicity thresholds

blocks.zh: 殘留量需符合 ISO 10993-7 等相關標準的限制
blocks.en: Residual levels must meet the limits of relevant standards such as ISO 10993-7

blocks.zh: 歐盟環境法規對 EtO 排放有嚴格限制，推動了 H₂O₂ 蒸汽（VHP）的普及
blocks.en: EU environmental regulations place strict limits on EtO emissions, which has driven the wider adoption of hydrogen peroxide vapour (VHP)

blocks.zh: VHP（汽化過氧化氫）在無菌製造的應用
blocks.en: Use of VHP (Vaporised Hydrogen Peroxide) in Aseptic Manufacturing

blocks.zh: VHP（Vaporised Hydrogen Peroxide）已成為現代無菌製藥工廠最重要的氣體滅菌技術之一，主要用途：
blocks.en: VHP (Vaporised Hydrogen Peroxide) has become one of the most important gas sterilisation technologies in modern aseptic pharmaceutical plants. Its main uses are:

blocks.zh: 隔離器（Isolator）的生物去污（Biodecontamination）
blocks.en: Biodecontamination of isolators

blocks.zh: RABS（限制存取隔離系統）的去污
blocks.en: Decontamination of RABS (restricted access barrier systems)

blocks.zh: 無菌包材轉移入 Grade A 區域的表面去污
blocks.en: Surface decontamination of sterile packaging materials transferred into Grade A areas

blocks.zh: 設備表面在線（In-situ）去污
blocks.en: In-situ decontamination of equipment surfaces

blocks.zh: VHP 的優點：分解後僅產生水和氧氣，環境友好；週期時間短；材料相容性廣。
blocks.en: Advantages of VHP: it decomposes into only water and oxygen and is environmentally friendly; cycle times are short; and material compatibility is broad.

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤 Common Misconception
blocks.en: Common Misconception

blocks.zh: 錯誤：EtO 滅菌等同於最終滅菌（Terminal Sterilisation）
blocks.en: Wrong: EtO sterilisation is the same as terminal sterilisation

blocks.zh: 正確：EtO 屬於氣體滅菌（Gas Sterilisation），主要用於表面滅菌，不屬於 Ph.Eur. 偏好的「最終容器中滅菌」。EtO 無法被用於液體製品的最終滅菌。
blocks.en: Correct: EtO is a gas sterilisation method used mainly for surface sterilisation; it is not the "sterilisation in the final container" preferred by Ph.Eur. EtO cannot be used for the terminal sterilisation of liquid products.

blocks.zh: Membrane Filtration / 膜過濾滅菌
blocks.en: Membrane Filtration

blocks.zh: 去除機制、0.22 µm、完整性測試、滅菌濾膜、7 項常規監控參數 | Removal Mechanism, 0.22 µm, Integrity Tests, Sterilising Filter, 7 Routine Parameters
blocks.en: Removal Mechanism, 0.22 µm, Integrity Tests, Sterilising Filter, 7 Routine Parameters

blocks.zh: 過濾「去除」而非「滅活」的重要含義
blocks.en: What "Removal" Rather Than "Inactivation" Means for Filtration

blocks.zh: 膜過濾的滅菌機制是物理去除（Removal），而非蒸汽/乾熱/輻射的「滅活（Inactivation）」。這意味著：
blocks.en: The sterilising mechanism of membrane filtration is physical removal, not the "inactivation" achieved by steam, dry heat or radiation. This means that:

blocks.zh: 微生物仍然存活，只是被截留在膜的上游面
blocks.en: The microorganisms are still viable; they are merely retained on the upstream face of the membrane

blocks.zh: 一旦濾膜完整性被破壞（如針孔），微生物可直接通過
blocks.en: Once the membrane integrity is compromised (for example by a pinhole), microorganisms can pass straight through

blocks.zh: 過濾前後的完整性測試（Integrity Test）是唯一能確認「這批過濾確實有效」的方法
blocks.en: Pre- and post-filtration integrity tests are the only way to confirm that "this filtration was actually effective"

blocks.zh: 過濾後的製品不能再接觸非無菌環境（必須立即在 Grade A 條件下操作）
blocks.en: The filtered product must not come into contact with a non-sterile environment again (it must be handled immediately under Grade A conditions)

blocks.zh: 膜過濾關鍵規格
blocks.en: Key Specifications of Membrane Filtration

blocks.zh: 標稱孔徑 ≤ 0.22 µm
blocks.en: Nominal pore size ≤ 0.22 µm

blocks.zh: 此孔徑基於對最小已知細菌（Brevundimonas diminuta）的截留能力驗證而設定
blocks.en: This pore size is set on the basis of validated retention of the smallest known bacterium (Brevundimonas diminuta)

blocks.zh: 過濾滅菌的 7 項常規監控要點
blocks.en: The 7 Routine Monitoring Points for Filtration Sterilisation

blocks.zh: 過濾前生物負載：確認每批次預過濾微生物污染水平（影響 SAL 計算）
blocks.en: Pre-filtration bioburden: confirm the microbial contamination level before filtration for each batch (affects the SAL calculation)

blocks.zh: 過濾前完整性測試：確認濾膜完好（過濾有效的前提）
blocks.en: Pre-filtration integrity test: confirm the filter is intact (a prerequisite for effective filtration)

blocks.zh: 過濾持續時間：長時間過濾可能導致膜污染或微生物穿透風險
blocks.en: Filtration duration: prolonged filtration may lead to membrane fouling or a risk of microbial grow-through

blocks.zh: 過濾體積：大體積可能超過濾膜容量，影響截留效率
blocks.en: Filtration volume: a large volume may exceed the capacity of the filter and affect retention efficiency

blocks.zh: 差壓：異常壓升可能提示膜堵塞或破損
blocks.en: Differential pressure: an abnormal pressure rise may indicate membrane blockage or damage

blocks.zh: 過濾後完整性測試：最關鍵的確認步驟——確認本批次過濾有效
blocks.en: Post-filtration integrity test: the most critical confirmation step, confirming that the filtration of this batch was effective

blocks.zh: 濾膜滅菌（在線或離線蒸汽）：使用前的滅菌處理記錄
blocks.en: Filter sterilisation (in-line or off-line steam): records of the sterilisation treatment before use

blocks.zh: Aseptic Assembly / 無菌組裝
blocks.en: Aseptic Assembly

blocks.zh: 定義、適用範圍、關鍵因素、培養基灌裝驗證、每批無菌試驗 | Definition, Scope, Critical Factors, Media Fill, Sterility Testing
blocks.en: Definition, Scope, Critical Factors, Media Fill, Sterility Testing of Each Batch

blocks.zh: 無菌組裝 vs 最終滅菌：核心風險差異
blocks.en: Aseptic Assembly vs Terminal Sterilisation: The Core Risk Difference

blocks.zh: 無菌組裝的本質是「維持（Maintain）已有的無菌狀態」，而最終滅菌是「創造（Create）無菌狀態」。這一根本差異決定了：
blocks.en: The essence of aseptic assembly is to "maintain" an existing sterile state, whereas terminal sterilisation "creates" a sterile state. This fundamental difference means that:

blocks.zh: 每次人員干預 = 污染風險事件：人員是最大的污染源，每次進入 Grade A 區域的動作都是潛在風險
blocks.en: Every human intervention is a contamination risk event: personnel are the greatest source of contamination, and every action in the Grade A area is a potential risk

blocks.zh: 無法實施參數放行：每批均需通過 Ph.Eur. 2.6.1 無菌試驗
blocks.en: Parametric release is not possible: every batch must pass the Ph.Eur. 2.6.1 sterility test

blocks.zh: 培養基灌裝（Media Fill）是驗證和監控的核心
blocks.en: Media fill is the core of validation and monitoring

blocks.zh: 培養基灌裝（Media Fill / Process Simulation Test）詳解
blocks.en: Media Fill (Process Simulation Test) in Detail

blocks.zh: 目的：以微生物培養基（通常是胰蛋白大豆肉湯，TSB）代替實際產品，模擬完整的灌裝操作，以驗證製程在正常和挑戰條件下不引入微生物污染。
blocks.en: Purpose: to simulate the complete filling operation using microbial growth medium (usually tryptic soy broth, TSB) in place of the actual product, in order to verify that the process does not introduce microbial contamination under normal and challenging conditions.

blocks.zh: 接受標準（PIC/S Annex 1 2022 參考）：
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria (based on PIC/S Annex 1, 2022):

blocks.zh: 灌裝單位 <5000：無污染（0 污染）
blocks.en: Units filled <5000: no contamination (0 contaminated units)

blocks.zh: 灌裝單位 5000–10000：1 個污染單位需調查；2 個需重做
blocks.en: Units filled 5000–10000: 1 contaminated unit requires investigation; 2 require a repeat

blocks.zh: 灌裝單位 >10000：1 個污染單位需調查；2 個需重做
blocks.en: Units filled >10000: 1 contaminated unit requires investigation; 2 require a repeat

blocks.zh: 頻率：初始驗證通常 3 次；之後每班次/產品線每半年至少一次。
blocks.en: Frequency: typically 3 runs for initial validation; thereafter at least once every six months per shift/product line.

blocks.zh: 現代無菌組裝的污染控制技術
blocks.en: Contamination Control Technologies in Modern Aseptic Assembly

blocks.zh: 隔離器（Isolator）：將人員完全隔離在密封腔體外，大幅降低人員污染風險；需 VHP 生物去污驗證
blocks.en: Isolator: completely separates personnel from the sealed enclosure, greatly reducing the risk of contamination by personnel; requires VHP biodecontamination validation

blocks.zh: RABS（限制存取隔離系統）：物理屏障 + 正壓保護，比傳統層流工作台更好的人員隔離
blocks.en: RABS (restricted access barrier system): physical barrier plus positive pressure protection, giving better separation of personnel than a conventional laminar flow workstation

blocks.zh: 連續監測（Continuous Environmental Monitoring）：在線粒子計數器 + 微生物採樣器，即時偵測異常
blocks.en: Continuous environmental monitoring: online particle counters plus microbiological samplers detect abnormalities in real time

blocks.zh: 自動化灌裝機器人：減少人員干預次數，降低污染機率
blocks.en: Automated filling robots: reduce the number of human interventions and the probability of contamination

blocks.zh: GMP Context / GMP 實務要點
blocks.en: GMP Context

blocks.zh: 最終滅菌偏好、參數放行、F₀ 決策、交叉參考、稽查準備 | Terminal Sterilisation Preference, Parametric Release, F₀, Cross-references, Audit Readiness
blocks.en: Terminal Sterilisation Preference, Parametric Release, F₀, Cross-references, Audit Readiness

blocks.zh: 為何最終滅菌是首選 Why Terminal Sterilisation is Preferred
blocks.en: Why Terminal Sterilisation is Preferred

blocks.zh: 監管立場 Regulatory Position
blocks.en: Regulatory Position

blocks.zh:
"Terminal sterilisation gives the greatest assurance of sterility. If a product can be terminally sterilised, it should be. Aseptic processing should only be used when terminal sterilisation is not possible."
— PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 核心原則
blocks.en:
"Terminal sterilisation gives the greatest assurance of sterility. If a product can be terminally sterilised, it should be. Aseptic processing should only be used when terminal sterilisation is not possible."
— PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) core principle

blocks.zh: 最終滅菌（Terminal Sterilisation）優先的原因：
blocks.en: Reasons why terminal sterilisation is preferred:

blocks.zh: 人員干預已結束：製品在密封最終容器中接受滅菌，滅菌後無需開啟，人員污染風險為零
blocks.en: Human intervention is finished: the product is sterilised in its sealed final container and does not need to be opened afterwards, so the risk of contamination by personnel is zero

blocks.zh: 可實施參數放行：F₀、溫度、壓力等物理製程數據可實時確認滅菌效果，毋須等待末端無菌試驗結果（14 天）
blocks.en: Parametric release is possible: physical process data such as F₀, temperature and pressure confirm sterilisation efficacy in real time, without waiting for the end-product sterility test result (14 days)

blocks.zh: 監管機關一致偏好：FDA、EMA、PIC/S、WHO 均在指引中明確表達此偏好
blocks.en: Consistent regulatory preference: FDA, EMA, PIC/S and WHO all express this preference explicitly in their guidance

blocks.zh: 更低的整體製程風險：環境監測要求相對簡單，不需 Grade A/B 的複雜環境控制
blocks.en: Lower overall process risk: environmental monitoring requirements are relatively simple, and the complex environmental controls of Grade A/B are not needed

blocks.zh: 參數放行實務 Parametric Release Practice
blocks.en: Parametric Release Practice

blocks.zh: 參數放行的三個前提條件
blocks.en: Three Prerequisites for Parametric Release

blocks.zh: 完全驗證的最終滅菌方法：蒸汽（通常 F₀ 計算）、乾熱（溫度時間曲線）或輻射（劑量測定）
blocks.en: A fully validated terminal sterilisation method: steam (usually by F₀ calculation), dry heat (time-temperature profile) or radiation (dosimetry)

blocks.zh: 主管機關核准：需向 EMA/FDA/各國藥管局申請並取得正式批准，是製劑上市許可（MA）的一部分
blocks.en: Competent Authority approval: a formal application must be made to and approved by the EMA, FDA or national regulatory authority, as part of the marketing authorisation (MA) of the medicinal product

blocks.zh: 完善的即時監控系統：每週期的製程數據必須自動記錄、計算、並與預定接受標準比對
blocks.en: A robust real-time monitoring system: the process data of every cycle must be recorded automatically, calculated and compared with predefined acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: F₀ 決策框架 F₀ Decision Framework
blocks.en: F₀ Decision Framework

blocks.zh: F₀ 策略比較
blocks.en: Comparison of F₀ Strategies

blocks.zh: F₀ 關鍵數值
blocks.en: Key F₀ Values

blocks.zh: ≥8 min — Ph.Eur. 法規最低值
blocks.en: ≥8 min: Ph.Eur. regulatory minimum

blocks.zh: ≥15–25 min — 工業慣例目標
blocks.en: ≥15–25 min: industry convention target

blocks.zh: ≥12 min — Overkill 法最低要求（對標準 BI）
blocks.en: ≥12 min: minimum requirement for the overkill approach (for a standard BI)

blocks.zh: 實務考量 Practical Considerations
blocks.en: Practical Considerations

blocks.zh: CDMO 製程開發的 F₀ 決策流程
blocks.en: F₀ Decision Process in CDMO Process Development

blocks.zh: 評估製品熱穩定性：降解動力學研究（Arrhenius model）確認製品能耐受的最大熱暴露
blocks.en: Assess the thermal stability of the product: degradation kinetics studies (Arrhenius model) confirm the maximum heat exposure the product can tolerate

blocks.zh: 選擇驗證策略：耐熱製品優先 Overkill；熱敏感製品考慮生物負載法
blocks.en: Select the validation strategy: for heat-resistant products, overkill is preferred; for heat-sensitive products, consider the bioburden-based approach

blocks.zh: 設計最差條件（Worst Case）：最大容器、最滿裝量、最冷位置為驗證基準
blocks.en: Design the worst case: the largest container, the fullest fill volume and the coldest position serve as the validation basis

blocks.zh: 確認監控計畫：確保每週期 F₀ 計算系統的校驗狀態
blocks.en: Confirm the monitoring plan: ensure the calibration status of the F₀ calculation system for every cycle

blocks.zh: 建立生物負載限度：即使採用 Overkill 法，仍需設立預警限（Alert Limit）
blocks.en: Establish bioburden limits: even when the overkill approach is used, an alert limit still needs to be set

blocks.zh: F₀ 的直觀理解
blocks.en: An Intuitive Understanding of F₀

blocks.zh: F₀ 是一個「等效時間」——無論實際溫度曲線多複雜，F₀ 把整個過程換算成「等效於在 121°C 飽和蒸汽中曝露多少分鐘」。
blocks.en: F₀ is an "equivalent time": however complex the actual temperature profile, F₀ converts the whole process into "the equivalent number of minutes of exposure to saturated steam at 121°C".

blocks.zh: F₀ 值 = 把所有溫度點的滅菌效果「折現」換算成 121°C 的等效分鐘數，是評估蒸汽滅菌週期有效性的通用貨幣。
blocks.en: The F₀ value "discounts" the sterilising effect at every temperature point into equivalent minutes at 121°C, and is the common currency for assessing the effectiveness of a steam sterilisation cycle.

blocks.zh: 重要交叉參考 Key Cross-References
blocks.en: Key Cross-References

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤與迷思 Common Mistakes and Misconceptions
blocks.en: Common Mistakes and Misconceptions

blocks.zh: 稽查中常見缺失 / 學習常見誤解
blocks.en: Common Audit Findings / Common Learning Misunderstandings

blocks.zh: [錯誤 1] 將過濾滅菌視為「最終滅菌」：膜過濾不是最終滅菌（Terminal Sterilisation），過濾後仍需在無菌條件下操作，且每批必須通過無菌試驗（2.6.1）。
blocks.en: [Mistake 1] Treating filtration sterilisation as "terminal sterilisation": membrane filtration is not terminal sterilisation; after filtration the product must still be handled under aseptic conditions, and every batch must pass the sterility test (2.6.1).

blocks.zh: [錯誤 2] 僅依賴末端無菌試驗作為放行依據：Ph.Eur. 5.1.1 明確指出無菌保證來自整個製程驗證，而非單一末端測試。
blocks.en: [Mistake 2] Relying solely on the end-product sterility test as the basis for release: Ph.Eur. 5.1.1 states clearly that sterility assurance comes from validation of the whole process, not from a single end-product test.

blocks.zh: [錯誤 3] 混淆 EtO（氣體）滅菌與最終容器滅菌：EtO 是表面氣體滅菌，用於包材和設備，不適用於液體製品的最終滅菌。
blocks.en: [Mistake 3] Confusing EtO (gas) sterilisation with sterilisation in the final container: EtO is a surface gas sterilisation method used for packaging materials and equipment and is not suitable for the terminal sterilisation of liquid products.

blocks.zh: [錯誤 4] 忽略過濾後完整性測試：過濾前的完整性測試確認「起點合格」；過濾後的測試確認「本批過濾有效」，兩者缺一不可。
blocks.en: [Mistake 4] Ignoring the post-filtration integrity test: the pre-filtration integrity test confirms that the "starting point is acceptable"; the post-filtration test confirms that "the filtration of this batch was effective"; neither can be omitted.

blocks.zh: [錯誤 5] 認為 F₀ ≥8 min 是充足的工業目標：8 min 是 Ph.Eur. 規定的最低值，大多數成熟製程設計目標為 15–25 min 以提供充分的安全邊際。
blocks.en: [Mistake 5] Believing that F₀ ≥8 min is an adequate industrial target: 8 min is the minimum value specified by Ph.Eur.; most mature processes are designed for 15–25 min to provide an adequate safety margin.

blocks.zh: [錯誤 6] 除熱原驗證使用生物指示劑：乾熱除熱原驗證使用熱耐性內毒素挑戰，不使用 BI。
blocks.en: [Mistake 6] Using biological indicators for depyrogenation validation: dry heat depyrogenation validation uses a heat-resistant endotoxin challenge, not a BI.
